delete.summary: Delete an unused brand (otherwise deactivate it).

get.summary: All categories (flat, incl. inactive); build the tree from parentId.

put.summary: Update name, order, active flag and attribute schema (If-Match). Slug and parent are fixed.

delete.summary: Delete an unused leaf category (BR-09: otherwise deactivate it).

get.summary: Paged product list incl. drafts and archived.

post.summary: Create a draft. The slug is generated from the name unless given.

get.summary: Full product incl. drafts. The ETag is the version to send back in If-Match.

put.summary: Replace details and attributes (If-Match required, 412 on a stale version).
Set the variant options (max 3 options, 20 values each).
Create or replace a variant. SKUs are unique across all products (409).

delete.summary: Remove a variant (stock check arrives with the inventory service).

put.summary: Ordered image list (absolute URLs until the media service exists).

post.summary: Return a published product to draft.
Archive: hidden from the storefront, still resolvable by id for past orders.

get.summary: Active category tree for the navigation menu (cached).
Category with its attribute schema (filterable attributes drive the facets).
Published products. Filter by category/brand slug, sort by newest|price_asc|price_desc|name, or fetch a batch with ids=a,b,c (max 50, input order).
Published product detail (Redis cache-aside). Draft and archived products are 404.

Bearer.description: Access token from /api/v1/auth/login (admin endpoints need catalog:write)
